Overview and Setup¶

The GradCafe Analytics application is a Flask-based application that displays analysis results from GradCafe admissions data stored in PostgreSQL.

Environment Variables¶

The application uses the following environment variable:

DATABASE_URL

This variable stores the PostgreSQL connection string.

Run the Application¶

From the Module_4 folder, run:

python src/app.py

Open the application at:

http://127.0.0.1:5000/analysis

Run Tests¶

Run all marked tests with:

pytest -m "web or buttons or analysis or db or integration"
